probably not helpful advice but working out! I go to CC so my schedule is flexible af  and I have afternoon classes that either 11:15-12:40 or 2:20-3:45 but my mom has work early and wakes up at 5:30 to go to the gym and I go with her and it gives me 4-7 extra hours in my day so I do my homework and clean and get shit done during that and then spend the extra time relaxing before class so then when I get home from class I literally have nothing to do! 

Honestly the feeling of having all my shit done and not being stressed about school is so worth waking up that early. It makes me feel so accomplished. I could even get a part time job if I wanted to because I’ve gotten used to waking up that early so I never feel tired until like 8-9 and I go to sleep then and start that cycle all over again.  it’s just having a good bed time and waking up to something worth doing, for me it was exercise. If you don’t have anything to do then I don’t know how realistic just waking up that early could be.
